headline: Evercore ISI Downgrades Reddit Stock Amid User Growth Concerns
summary: Evercore ISI adjusted its rating on Reddit stock downward, citing concerns regarding user growth metrics.
why: Analyst downgrades and user growth trajectories directly influence investor sentiment and equity valuations for social media platforms.

impacts.name: Reddit Inc
impacts.why: Lowered ratings from major financial institutions typically trigger downward pressure on stock prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Analyst rating cuts regarding user growth metrics signal potential headwinds for future monetization and revenue expansion.
